projectIsActive.evidence: Project repository fetches project; active status filter exists in UI cache queries but explicit assertion in TripService is partial

userIsAuthenticated.evidence: server.ts authenticateUser middleware + context.userId in TripService

referencedDriverIsValidAndActive.evidence: TripService.dispatchTrip checks driverRepository.findById and driver.status === 'ACTIVE' and driver.carrierId === carrierId

referencedTruckIsValidAndActive.evidence: TripService.dispatchTrip checks truckRepository.findById and truck.status === 'ACTIVE' and truck.carrierId === carrierId

rosterRelationshipIsActive.evidence: TripService checks project.authorizedCarrierIds and authorizedMaterialIds; dedicated ProjectCarrierRoster validation is partial during replay

expectedVersionMatches.evidence: Handled in ConflictResolutionService.detectConflict for updates; not asserted uniformly across all mutation endpoints

operationIdNotPreviouslyCommitted.evidence: Checked via syncOperationRepository and server.ts clientUUID query

staleOrDeletedTargetRejectedSafely.evidence: TripService repository lookups fail if entity is deleted

retryAfterPartialFailureIsSafe.evidence: Idempotent replay returns existing entity without duplicate writes

operationIdTrace.serverValidation: server.ts queries Firestore collection projects/:projectId/trips where clientUUID == operationId

expectedVersionTrace.capture: Captured on client during initial load/mutation (OutboxOperation.payload.version)
